app.name: Laufleer
app.description: Discover restaurants across Germany, browse the menu and reserve a table in a few steps.

demo.title: Demo version
demo.notice: Laufleer is not yet in operation. Restaurants can already register; approved profiles then appear here.
demo.bookingWarning: This is a demo application. Your details are not sent to any restaurant — no valid reservation is created.
demo.successWarning: This confirmation is part of a demo. No table has been reserved at a real restaurant.

signUp.heading: Create account
signUp.subheading: Collect points on every visit and keep track of your reservations. Booking still works without an account.
signUp.acceptTerms: I have read and accept the privacy policy.
signUp.checkEmailText: We have sent you an email. Open the link inside — then you complete your profile.

signIn2.subheading: Log in to see your points and reservations.

complete.pointsFound: We found points already collected for this email address — they will be credited to your account.

points.intro: You collect points per restaurant. At {threshold} points you automatically get a discount voucher.
points.noneHint: Collecting starts with your first visit — the restaurant confirms it on site.
points.rewardAuto: Applied automatically to your next reservation.

bookings.noneHint: As soon as you reserve a table, it appears here.
bookings.tooLateHint: To cancel, please call the restaurant directly — the reservation starts in less than {hours} hours.

dashboard.comingSoon: Reservations and points will appear here once available.

forgot.subheading: Enter your email address. We will send you a link to set a new password.

reset.heading: New password
reset.subheading: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.doneText: You can now log in with your new password.

landing.heading: Your restaurant on Laufleer
landing.subheading: Create a profile, keep your details up to date yourself and take reservations. Free, no contract.
landing.step1Text: Register with your email address and a password.
landing.step2Text: Add address, cuisine, opening hours and a photo.
landing.step3Text: We check the details. Once approved, your restaurant is publicly visible.

gate.text: This area is not public yet. Laufleer is in preparation and is currently not accepting registrations.
gate.lockedText: The area for restaurants is currently closed. Laufleer is in preparation and is not accepting registrations yet.

signUp.subheading: First create an account. Restaurant details come in the next step.

menu.intro: Create categories and add dishes to them.
menu.noItems: No dishes in this category yet.

tables.heading: Tables
tables.intro: Add your tables with their seat counts. On booking, the smallest suitable free table is chosen automatically.
tables.label: Label
tables.noTables: No tables yet. Without tables no reservations are possible.

loyalty.heading: Loyalty programme
loyalty.intro: Award points for every visit. Guests collect per restaurant.
loyalty.pointsPerVisitHint: Credited automatically when you mark a reservation as visited.
loyalty.thresholdHint: As soon as a guest reaches this number, a voucher is created automatically and the points are deducted — collecting starts again.
loyalty.cycleExample: Example: {perVisit} point(s) per visit, voucher at {threshold} points — so roughly every {visits}. visit earns {percent}% off.
loyalty.noMembers: No members yet. Points appear once you mark a reservation as visited.
loyalty.disabledHint: The loyalty programme is disabled. No points are awarded.

profile.descriptionPlaceholder: What makes your restaurant special? Two or three sentences is enough.
profile.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, maximum 5 MB.
profile.submitHint: After submitting we review your details. While the review is running, the profile is not public.

status.pendingText: We are checking your details. You can still save changes.
status.rejectedText: Please revise the details and submit again.

impressum.heading: Legal notice (Impressum)
impressum.placeholder: Laufleer is under development and is not in operation. No services are offered and no contracts are concluded. The details required under § 5 TMG (provider, contact, VAT ID, person responsible for content) will be added before launch.

datenschutz.heading: Privacy policy
datenschutz.placeholder: Laufleer is a demo application under development. No analytics or tracking services are used; only strictly necessary cookies are set. Data entered in the reservation form is stored for testing purposes only, in a database inside the EU (Frankfurt am Main), and is not forwarded to any restaurant.
datenschutz.warning: Please do not enter real personal data.
datenschutz.later: The full information required under GDPR Art. 13 will be added before launch.

cookies.message: We only use strictly necessary cookies. No tracking or analytics cookies are set.
